title: Designing splash cymbals with Zildjian
summary: He tells how he moved from Leedy to Ludwig drums and got Zildjian to make a thin splash cymbal to his specification.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
